newsitem.title: UK: Sierra Leone suspended from Commonwealth meetings.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Leone suspended from Commonwealth meetings.

text.p: Commonwealth ministers said on Friday the military junta in Sierra Leone would be suspended from taking part in Commonwealth meetings until the democratically elected government was restored.

"Participation of the junta in Sierra Leone in Commonwealth councils would be suspended forthwith," Zimbabwean Foreign Minister Stan Mudenge told a news conference after closed-door talks of the Commonwealth Ministerial Action Group in London.
Civilian president Ahmad Tejan Kabbah was toppled in a coup on May 25 and chaos has since reigned in the west African state.

The ministers, who held two days of talks on democracy within member states of the Commonwealth, called for the "immediate and unconditional reinstatement of the democratically elected government of Sierra Leone".
The Commonwealth mainly groups Britain and its former colonies and protectorates.
